title: invoice-delivery-worker
blurb: At-least-once invoice commands duplicate customer deliveries, retry in hot loops, and never reach their terminal failure queue.
brief:
Workers deliver finalized invoices to customer accounting integrations. The queue is at-least-once, so redelivery and duplicate commands are normal. Production found three failures: duplicate invoices, immediate retry storms, and commands that circulate forever.

The queue, sink, and clock are deterministic test doubles. Read their contracts before changing `invoice_delivery/worker.py`; do not add sleeps or serialize all workers behind a global application lock.

**Your job:** make effects idempotent, acknowledge only after safe processing, schedule exponential retries, and park a command after its fifth failed attempt.
